'''''Retama sphaerocarpa''''' is a flowering bush species in the genus ''[[Retama]]'', native to the [[Iberian Peninsula]] ([[Portugal]] and [[Spain]]) and [[North Africa]] ([[Morocco]], [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]]).<ref name="powo"></ref>
